description: Detects the chain of an address and validates it offline: Bitcoin Base58Check and bech32/bech32m, EVM EIP-55 checksum, Solana Base58 length. 0.001 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: address_validate
